candidates.title: As the Deer

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lines: As the deer panteth for the water so my soul longeth after Thee
You alone are my hearts desire and I long to worship Thee
You alone are my strength, my shield
To You alone may my spirit yield

lyrics.label: Chorus
lines: You alone are my hearts desire and I long to worship Thee
You're my friend and You are my brother
Even though You are a King I love You more than any other

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lines: You alone are my strength, my shield
To You alone may my spirit yield
You alone are my hearts desire and I long to worship Thee
I want You more than gold or silver

lyrics.label: Bridge
lines: You alone are the real joy giver and the apple of My eye
You alone are my strength, my shield
To You alone make my spirit yield

lyrics.label: Tag
lines: You alone are my hearts desire and I long to worship Thee

candidates.notes: Corrected spelling (dear→deer, herarts→hearts, youre→you're). Capitalized each line start and You/Your when referring to God.
